facts.text: I have a rash on the upper half of my back.
It came on suddenly last night.
I find this rash very concerning, especially because it came on so suddenly.
The inside of my mouth has become sore and inflamed.
The cough is new; it started recently.
I don't recall being exposed to anything new, like detergents or plants such as poison ivy.
I don't have joint pains at the moment.
I don't have any stomach or bowel problems.
I haven't been ill with anything else recently.

facts.item: recent visits to a primary care provider
facts.text: I recently started seeing a primary care provider to manage my arthritis and this new cough.
Apart from the arthritis, I don't have any other significant medical history.

findings.name: skin examination
findings.result: Coalescing erythematous macules, bullae and desquamation, localized to the upper half of the back.

findings.name: oral examination
findings.result: Ulcers and erythema in the oropharynx.

findings.name: heart auscultation
findings.result: Normal rate and rhythm; no murmurs or gallops.

findings.name: lung auscultation
findings.result: Clear to auscultation bilaterally; no wheezes, rales or rhonchi.

findings.name: abdominal examination
findings.result: Soft, non-tender; no hepatosplenomegaly; normoactive bowel sounds throughout.

findings.name: complete blood count
findings.result: WBC normal; hemoglobin normal; platelets normal.

findings.name: basic metabolic panel
findings.result: Renal function tests normal; electrolytes normal.

findings.name: skin biopsy of back lesion
findings.result: Epidermal necrosis and detachment, consistent with a severe drug reaction.

f004: The source says 'mucositis' / 'mucosal changes' without a site; the mouth is used because the exam finds oropharyngeal ulcers (x007).
f010: The ROS denies joint pains although the patient has diagnosed arthritis under management; kept as a current denial.
f015: 'No other significant past medical history has been mentioned' is a meta phrase; converted to a plain denial per CONVERSION.md ('No notable past medical history provided' becomes a denial).

source_issues: Gold label misspelled 'Steven-Johnson syndrome'; corrected to 'Stevens-Johnson syndrome' (the misspelling is kept as a gold alias).
Heart rate 125/min while the cardiac exam reports 'normal rate'.
The ROS denies joint pains although the patient has diagnosed arthritis.
No culprit drug is named anywhere, although the biopsy calls the picture a severe drug reaction and the patient recently started care for arthritis and cough.
notes: The patient's concern about the sudden rash is kept as his own worry (social_background, f003), merging the History and p002.
'Skin and mucosal changes' in the ROS merge with the rash (f001) and the mouth soreness (f004).
Renal function tests and electrolytes are grouped as a basic metabolic panel (x012); liver function tests are their own panel (x013).
The biopsy result ('severe drug reaction') does not name the diagnosis, so it is not listed as leakage.
check_coverage warns that the gold label differs from the source: this is only the spelling correction (Steven- to Stevens-Johnson).

excluded_sources.reason: 'The patient didn't provide any specific social history details during the initial consultation' carries no patient information.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with a concerning rash and recent health changes.
